# React UI Task

Implement the requested UI change using `agents/react-ui.agent.md`.

Apply `skills/architecture.skill.md` and `skills/ui_standards.skill.md`; use the selected Tailwind, Material UI, Chakra UI, or shadcn/ui conventions only when configured or requested.

Inspect routes, components, providers, theme tokens, icons, forms, and test conventions before editing. Prefer named exports, typed props, semantic landmarks, visible focus, accessible labels, keyboard navigation, responsive layouts, and explicit loading/empty/error/pending/success states. Keep API calls and business rules in hooks or the state/API layer, not in presentational components. Use React Router search params for shareable filters and search.

Run focused tests first, then lint, typecheck, and build. Report changed components and residual risk.
